message.name: TransferInstructionStatusReportV10
message.definition: Scope|The TransferInstructionStatusReport message is sent by an executing party, for example, a transfer agent, to the instructing party, for example, an investment manager or one of its authorised representatives to provide the status of a previously received request for holdings information, portfolio transfer or transfer instruction.| It may also be used to report the status of an event related to the asset being transferred or provide additional information.|The TransferInstructionStatusReport message may also be sent by any party in the transfer transaction to another party in the transfer transaction chain to provide information relevant for the settlement of a transfer transaction. |Usage|The TransferInstructionStatusReport message is used to provide the status of a previously received request for holdings information, portfolio transfer or transfer instruction, or in response to a RequestForTransferStatus message. It may also be used to report the status of an event related to the asset being transferred or provide additional information.

rules.name: OtherRule
rules.text: If Reason/Code/OTHR (Other) is present, then AdditionReasonInformation must be present and the reason for the rejection status must be provided.

rules.name: IdentificationGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: HoldingTransferCurrencyGuideline
rules.text: When cash is transferred in a currency other than that of the cash, the currency should be specified in TransferCurrency.

rules.name: DiscountElementRule
rules.text: Amount Or Rate Or Basis must be present.

rules.name: AppliedAmountRule
rules.text: If InformativeIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then AppliedAmount must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: NonStandardSLAReferenceRule
rules.text: For each value of IndividualFee/Type, NonStandardSLAReference may only be present once.

rules.name: TransactionOverheadElementRule
rules.text: One of the elements (TotalOverheadApplied, TotalFees, TotalTaxes, CommercialAgreementReference, IndividualFee, IndividualTax) must be present.

rules.name: IdentificationGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: BeneficiaryDetailsRule
rules.text: If RecipientOfDrawdownIndicator is "false" or "0" (No), then BeneficiaryDetails is not allowed.|If RecipientOfDrawdownIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then BeneficiaryDetails may be present.

rules.name: TransferStatusEventType1Rule
rules.text: If at least one occurence of TransferEventType is Information (INFO) then TransferStatus/Status/Status must be equal to Received (RECE).

rules.name: TransferStatusEventType2Rule
rules.text: If at least one occurence of TransferEventType is ConversionStatus (CONV) then TransferStatus/Status/Status must be equal to Received (RECE).

rules.name: ConversionRule
rules.text: If at least one occurence of TransferEventType is ConversionStatus (CONV) then Conversion must be present.

rules.name: ExtensionRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of the Registration Authority and without strict usage rules published by the Registration Authority.

rules.name: OtherReferenceRule
rules.text: Reference/OtherReference should be used to reference a transfer instruction or a transfer cancellation request 'message' sent in a proprietary way or used for a system reference. If Reference/OtherReference is present, Reference/OtherReference/MessageName must contain 'fax' or 'phone' or 'email', etc.

rules.name: RelatedReferenceRule
rules.text: If Reference/RelatedReference/MessageName is present, it must start with sese.001, sese.002, sese.005, sese.006, sese.009, sese.012 or sese.014.
